name: Can Tho
provinceNote: Vietnamese Wikipedia describes the city after the 2025 rearrangement as taking in the former Hậu Giang and Sóc Trăng provinces, about 6,360.83 km², with the administrative centre in phường Ninh Kiều. Decision 1519/QĐ-TTg of 2 December 2023, as the city legal-education portal reprints it, planned the pre-merger city at 1,440.40 km².
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: A Mekong Delta city on the Hau River, best known for the Cai Rang floating market at dawn. Watch boats trade fruit and vegetables, walk the Ninh Kieu riverside at night, see the old Binh Thuy house, and eat hu tieu noodles and crispy pancakes. Stay one night so you can be on the river early.
getThere: 165 km or 155 km; 120 km of expressway
seoTitle: Can Tho: river nights and the Cai Rang dawn market
seoDescription: Sleep in Ninh Kieu for the Cai Rang boats. Vietnam Tourism prints about 165 km from Ho Chi Minh City, Wikipedia 155 km, and a 120 km expressway.
intro: Wholesale boats crowd the river at Cái Răng while the light is still low, with fruit and vegetables hung on cây bẹo poles so a buyer can see the goods. Ninh Kiều is the quay you leave from, where the Hậu meets the Cần Thơ river, and the walk you come back to after dark.

Sleep in the centre if that dawn boat is the reason you came. Vietnam Tourism says a room there reaches Ninh Kiều, Chùa Ông, the Bình Thủy house, and Cái Răng. A same-morning ride from Ho Chi Minh City arrives after the wholesale boats have thinned.

After dark the quay is the evening. Sở Văn hóa, Thể thao và Du lịch thành phố Cần Thơ says river restaurants there run 19:30–21:00 with đờn ca tài tử. The Can Tho Portal of 4 January 2016 puts snack stalls on the quay from about 16:00 to 19:00 and tài tử on a yacht from 20:00 to 23:00. The night market on Hai Bà Trưng prints 17:00–22:00. Those clocks are all printed.

Breakfast on the market boats is hủ tiếu, bún riêu, and cà phê vợt. Later in town, Vietnam Tourism names nem nướng Cái Răng, a Can Tho crispy pancake, lẩu mắm, and canh chua. Đề Thám is the street Vietnam Tourism calls a primer for southern cooking.
gettingAround: Vietnam Tourism prints about 165 km from Ho Chi Minh City by motorbike or private car on the Mỹ Thuận–Cần Thơ expressway. Vietnamese Wikipedia prints 155 km between the city centres. Thanh Niên and Tạp chí Doanh nghiệp Việt Nam print a 120 km expressway corridor, which is the length of that road, not a third centre-to-centre distance. Thanh Niên says the corridor takes about 2 hours instead of 3.5 hours and shortens the old road by 50 km. Tạp chí Doanh nghiệp Việt Nam says hơn 2 giờ instead of about 3.5 hours. Both reports give a maximum of 90 km/h and a minimum of 60 km/h. Thanh Niên says two-way traffic opened on 30 December 2023. The inauguration report says temporary use from 07:00 on 25 December 2023. Fares and a toll: Check on arrival. Nhân Dân, on 15 October 2026, reported holds from 22:00 to 01:00 on 16–19 October 2026 for the Võ Văn Kiệt overpass. That window had ended by 22 October 2026. A later night closure: Check on arrival.

Vietnam Tourism says buy a bus ticket at bến xe Miền Đông in Ho Chi Minh City. Hours and the fare: Check on arrival. A scheduled public boat from Ho Chi Minh City was not on the accounts read for this city. Check on arrival. The four-day Mekong piece transfers from Tra Vinh to Can Tho in about three hours by car or bus. No passenger train ends in Can Tho. Vietnam Tourism’s approach from Hanoi is a train of 30 hours to Ho Chi Minh City, then a bus. Pháp Luật TP.HCM reports a Ministry of Construction pre-feasibility study for a future line of about 175.2 km, proposed for 2028–2035. A study is not a service.

Cần Thơ airport is also called Trà Nóc. Vietjet prints the IATA code VCA. Airports Corporation of Vietnam’s homepage extract prints the office at 179B Lê Hồng Phong, phường Thới An Đông, phone 0292 3844 301. Vietjet prints the same street number and phone, and a different ward line: Long Hoà, Bình Thủy. Vietjet’s table says about 2 hours 10 minutes for Hanoi–Can Tho and about 1 hour 30 minutes for Da Nang–Can Tho. Those figures use the word about. They are not a timetable. Minutes from the airport to Ninh Kiều: Check on arrival.

The base is Bến Ninh Kiều on Hai Bà Trưng. The department listing says you can walk the quay at any hour, gives a visit length of 120 minutes, prints the phone 02923820336, and marks a quay fee as đang cập nhật. Check on arrival for a quay ticket. Its clock fields of 12:00 SA–11:59 CH are a full-day form, not a closing time. The weekend pedestrian street has no printed hours. Check on arrival. Cái Răng is about 30 minutes by boat from the quay. The national dining page and a department reprint say 6 km by road. The Can Tho Portal of 4 January 2016 says a few kilometers. The department listing marks boat hire đang cập nhật. The department advice page prints 300,000–700,000 VND a boat, depending on the number of guests. Motorbike and taxi fares in town: Check on arrival.

stayAreas.name: Ninh Kiều riverside
stayAreas.summary: River rooms within walk of Bến Ninh Kiều, so the dawn boat is an early start rather than a drive from another town. Hotels and eating rooms cluster on that waterfront. Room rates: Check on arrival.

eat: Start with hủ tiếu passed boat to boat at Cái Răng, the Can Tho crispy pancake, and canh chua at dinner in town. Đề Thám is the eating street. The orchard tables at Mỹ Khánh come after the boats.
interestsBody: Dining is the dawn bowl on the boats, Đề Thám in town, and the garden plates at Mỹ Khánh.
The floating market is Cái Răng at dawn, with produce on the cây bẹo poles.
Ninh Kiều after dark is the lit quay, the snack stalls, and đờn ca tài tử on the river.
The old house is the Dương house in Bình Thủy. Đình Bình Thủy is the communal hall beside that visit, not the same ticket.
The museum on Hòa Bình is the rainy-hour stop, with about 5,000 objects and English captions.
Phong Điền is the orchard hour after the boats: Mỹ Khánh, the noodle workshops, and Trúc Lâm Phương Nam. Bằng Lăng is a separate ride toward Thốt Nốt.

interestGroups.title: Floating market
interestGroups.summary: The wholesale boats are the reason to sleep here.
body: Sellers hang a sample on a long pole, the cây bẹo. Breakfast boats sell hủ tiếu, bún riêu, and coffee. The department says the market’s trading culture was put on the national intangible-heritage list in 2016.

Viện kiểm sát nhân dân thành phố Cần Thơ names a second floating market at Phong Điền. Hours, a fare, and a road distance for Phong Điền were not printed by the department or by Vietnam Tourism. Check on arrival. Do not use Cái Răng’s clocks for that quieter market.

cards.title: Cai Rang floating market
cards.summary: Wholesale boats at dawn. The ride from Ninh Kiều is about 30 minutes.

cards.title: Phong Dien floating market
cards.summary: Farm boats at dawn about 17 km out, quieter than Cái Răng.

interestGroups.title: Ninh Kiều quay
interestGroups.summary: Sleep here, leave before dawn, and walk the river again after dark.
body: The department uses both phường Tân An, quận Ninh Kiều and phường Ninh Kiều for the quay along Hai Bà Trưng. Vietnam Tourism says the right bank of the Hậu, phường Tân An, and gives the park as 7,000 m². A bronze statue of Hồ Chí Minh is 7.2 m on a 3.6 m base, over 12 tons. From the quay you look toward Cầu Cần Thơ, finished in 2010, which the department calls the cable-stayed bridge with the longest main span in Southeast Asia when it was finished, and toward the green islets of Xóm Chài and cồn Ấu. Cồn Sơn is a different islet.

Chùa Ông stands on this walk at 32 Hai Bà Trưng. A department article says it was finished in 1896 on 532 m², founded by Hoa people from Quảng Châu and Triệu Khánh. Vietnam Tourism’s four-day piece says incense coils and a deep-red hall, built at the end of the 19th century. The department advice page says it was listed as a national historic site in 1993. A fee and a visit length: Check on arrival. The weekend pedestrian street runs on weekends. Hours of that street: Check on arrival.

Chợ cổ sits on the same walk. A department tour text places it on Hai Bà Trưng, phường Ninh Kiều, and says a first building around 1915. Daytime hours: Check on arrival. The night market listing is đường Hai Bà Trưng, phường Ninh Kiều, 17:00–22:00, with stalls setting up around 16:00, selling fruit, clothes, jewelry, handicrafts, and seafood. A footer line of 98 Phan Đình Phùng matches the tourism-centre block on other listings. It is not the market’s address on this evidence. The 2016 portal’s quay snacks, about 16:00–19:00, are the park stalls and may be the same crowd or a different row.

cards.title: Ninh Kiều quay
cards.summary: The Hậu, the boats, and the walk you come back to after Cái Răng.

cards.title: Ong Pagoda
cards.summary: The Cantonese hall of 1896 at 32 Hai Bà Trưng, free to enter.

interestGroups.title: Old house and communal house
interestGroups.summary: Bình Thủy’s Dương house, and the communal hall that does not share its ticket.
body: Vietnam Tourism says the Dương family built the house in 1870 and that it was named a national architectural and artistic monument in 2009. The department listing prints 08:00–16:00 and 20,000–50,000 VND. The national page prints no fee. No account says the communal house shares that gate.

Đình Bình Thủy is also called Long Tuyền Cổ Miếu. The department’s cultural list says the Kỳ Yên Thượng Điền festival is held here each year and honors early settlers. The lunar date: Check on arrival. The city’s top-7 page names Lễ Thượng Điền and Lễ Hạ Điền at Bến Ninh Kiều. It does not say those are the same rite. A fee for the hall: Check on arrival.

cards.title: Binh Thuy ancient house
cards.summary: Five bays, cloth, lanterns, and teacups, at 144 Bùi Hữu Nghĩa.

cards.title: Binh Thuy communal house
cards.summary: Long Tuyền Cổ Miếu, and the Kỳ Yên that honors early settlers.

interestGroups.title: City museum
interestGroups.summary: A standing collection on Hòa Bình when the river day needs a roof.
body: Vietnam Tourism says the museum was established in 1976, on 2,700 m², with about 5,000 objects: history of people in Can Tho, plant and fish specimens, and rice work of Kinh, Hoa, and Khmer people, with English captions. The museum site’s footer prints Số 1 đại lộ Hòa Bình, phường Ninh Kiều. Vietnam Tourism prints no. 1 Hoa Binh Avenue, Tan An, Ninh Kieu. A fee and the hours: Check on arrival. The national text is a standing description, not a list of current exhibitions.

Munirangsyaram stands on the same avenue, at 36 Hòa Bình. Trung tâm Xúc tiến Đầu tư – Thương mại và Du lịch says entry is free, the hours are 08:00–18:00 every day, a 1948 start in bamboo and leaf, a 1954 gate in an Angkor-style triple tower, and a main hall continued in 1964 and inaugurated in 1988. Vietnam Airlines still says phường Tân An. Festival dates there: Check on arrival. It is not Chùa Ông.

cards.title: Can Tho Museum
cards.summary: About 5,000 objects on Hòa Bình, with English captions.

interestGroups.title: Phong Điền and the orchard road
interestGroups.summary: Fruit gardens after the market, then the long ride to the storks if you have the hours.
body: The 2016 portal writes the day as the floating market from 5:00, fruit gardens at midday, then the quay. Mỹ Khánh is about 10 km from the centre on the department advice page, at 335 Lộ Vòng Cung. A department tour text says more than 30 ha. A one-day article on the department site says more than 50,000 m². Newer tour lines say phường An Bình. Older lines say xã Mỹ Khánh, huyện Phong Điền. The advice page names dog racing, pig racing, a day as a landowner, draining a ditch for fish, boating, fishing, a craft visit, tài tử, and a monkey act. A fee and the minutes from Ninh Kiều: Check on arrival.

Vietnam Tourism describes a traditional noodle village in Can Tho and a hủ tiếu pizza tasting after the sheets are made. A department tour text places a noodle workshop at Mỹ Khánh. A counted visit and a fee: Check on arrival.

Thiền viện Trúc Lâm Phương Nam is a few hundred metres from Mỹ Khánh and about 15 km from the centre, on đường Mỹ Nhơn. The advice page calls it nearly 4 ha, the largest zen monastery in the delta on that account, with timber columns, tile roofs, and ship-tile floors. It also prints a construction value of 145 billion VND. That figure is not a ticket. A fee and the hours: Check on arrival.

Cồn Sơn, in the Hậu at Bình Thủy, is about 70 hectares on Vietnam Tourism. The boat from the Cổ Bắc ferry is about 5–10 minutes, and a boat can also be hired at Ninh Kiều. The same account lists bánh bò lụi, bánh ít, bánh bột lọc, bánh lá mít, bánh da lợn, bánh đúc, bánh xèo, and bánh khọt. A fee: Check on arrival. It is not cồn Ấu.

Vườn cò Bằng Lăng is in Thốt Nốt. Vietnam Tourism says 60 km from the centre, 20 stork species, 300,000 storks, and 16,500 m². The department advice page says about 50 km on National Route 91 and about 1.5 ha, formed in 1983. A 2020 article carried on the department site says Thới Bình 1, phường Thuận An, 60 km, a start at 13,097 m² and later 16,500 m², and also more than 15 ha and more than 300,000 birds. The article says the birds leave around 5:00–6:00 and return at dusk. Breeding months are lunar August to lunar January for the flock, and lunar February–April for cò ma. Civil dates: Check on arrival. A fee and a counted visit: Check on arrival.

cards.title: Truc Lam Phuong Nam
cards.summary: Tiled halls and a garden court on the Mỹ Khánh road.

cards.title: My Khanh tourist village
cards.summary: Orchards, pig races, and a 115-year-old house on the Cần Thơ river.

cards.title: Con Son islet
cards.summary: Fish rafts, folk cakes, and garden fruit on an islet in the Hậu.

faqs.q: Is a day trip from Ho Chi Minh City enough?
faqs.a: It can reach the delta. It does not put you on the water for the wholesale boats. Vietnam Tourism’s floating-flavour page says be on the water by 5:00 or 5:30, leaving Ninh Kiều around 5:00. Sleep in Can Tho.

faqs.q: How far is Can Tho from Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: Vietnam Tourism prints about 165 km. Vietnamese Wikipedia prints 155 km between the centres. Thanh Niên and Tạp chí Doanh nghiệp Việt Nam print 120 km of expressway, about 2 hours or hơn 2 giờ, against about 3.5 hours before that corridor. The 120 km is the expressway length, not a third centre distance. A toll: Check on arrival.
In the centre, within walk of Bến Ninh Kiều, so the dawn boat is honest. Room rates: Check on arrival. The evening is the quay, not a named bar street. A quiet hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

faqs.q: What does the Cái Răng boat cost?
faqs.a: The department listing marks the price đang cập nhật. The department advice page prints 300,000–700,000 VND a boat, depending on the number of guests. A ticket at the market is also đang cập nhật. Check on arrival.

faqs.q: Can I take a train to Can Tho?
faqs.a: No passenger station is open. Do not plan a train that ends here. Vietnam Tourism’s Hanoi approach is 30 hours by train to Ho Chi Minh City, then a bus. A studied Ho Chi Minh City–Can Tho line is not a service.

Óoc Om Bóc and the Ngo boat race, Kỳ Yên Thượng Điền at Đình Bình Thủy, the river-culture festival, the southern folk-cake festival, and the city’s food week are on the department’s lists. The blurbs do not print the next civil dates. Check on arrival. Lễ Thượng Điền and Lễ Hạ Điền are named at Ninh Kiều and are not described as the same rite as the Bình Thủy Kỳ Yên.

season.label: Dry months, fruit, then the flood boat
season.note: Vietnam Tourism prints a dry season from December to April, fruit in the gardens from June to August, and a flood season from September to November, which is when that account suggests the boat to Cái Răng. Flowers near Tết fall in December and January. The average is about 28°C, warm and humid all year. The market has no printed closed season. A flood closure of the expressway was not printed. Check on arrival for a road closure.
